instruction: From now on, please always put my toy blocks in the purple toy box, my mugs on the cyan tray and my books on the orange tray. Tidy the desk that way now.

attempts.code:
obs = observe()
book = obs["objects"]["red_book"]
zone = obs["zones"]["orange_tray"]
book_center = book["center"]
zone_center = zone["center"]
dx = zone_center[0] - book_center[0]
dy = zone_center[1] - book_center[1]
grasp_height = book["height"] / 2
yaw = book["long_axis_yaw"] if book["footprint_long"] < 0.08 else book["short_axis_yaw"]
pick("red_book", grasp_height, yaw)
place("orange_tray", dx, dy)
